<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

// WooCommerce sample products data - core products from WooCommerce sample data
$sample_products = array(
    array(

            array('name' => 'Color', 'options' => array('Blue', 'Green', 'Red'), 'visible' => true, 'variation' => true),
            array('name' => 'Size', 'options' => array('Small', 'Medium', 'Large'), 'visible' => true, 'variation' => true)
        )
    ),
    array(

        'sku' => 'woo-beanie'
    ),
    array(

        'type' => 'simple',
        'regular_price' => '65.00',
        'sale_price' => '55.00',
        'description' => 'Genuine leather belt with metal buckle.',
        'short_description' => 'Leather belt.',

        'sku' => 'woo-belt'
    ),
    array(

        'description' => 'Classic baseball cap.',
        'short_description' => 'Baseball cap.',

        'sku' => 'woo-cap'
    ),
    array(
        'name' => 'Sunglasses',
        'type' => 'simple',
        'regular_price' => '90.00',
        'description' => 'Stylish sunglasses with UV protection.',
        'short_description' => 'UV protection sunglasses.',
        'categories' => array('Accessories'),
        'sku' => 'woo-sunglasses'
    ),
    array(
        'name' => 'Hoodie with Logo',
        'type' => 'simple',
        'regular_price' => '45.00',
        'description' => 'Premium hoodie with embroidered logo.',
        'short_description' => 'Hoodie with logo.',
        'categories' => array('Hoodies'),
        'sku' => 'woo-hoodie-with-logo'
    ),
    array(
        'name' => 'T-Shirt with Logo',
        'type' => 'simple',
        'regular_price' => '25.00',
        'description' => 'Premium t-shirt with printed logo.',
        'short_description' => 'T-shirt with logo.',
        'categories' => array('Tshirts'),

    ),
    array(

    ),
    array(

    ),
    array(

    ),
    array(

        'categories' => array('Hoodies'),
        'sku' => 'woo-hoodie-with-zipper'
    ),
    array(
        'name' => 'V-Neck T-Shirt',
        'type' => 'simple',
        'regular_price' => '18.00',
        'description' => 'Classic v-neck t-shirt.',
        'short_description' => 'V-neck tee.',
        'categories' => array('Tshirts'),
        'sku' => 'woo-vneck-tee'
    )
);

// Create product categories first
$category_ids = array();
$categories = array('Hoodies', 'Tshirts', 'Accessories', 'Music');

foreach ($categories as $cat_name) {
    $term = term_exists($cat_name, 'product_cat');
    if (!$term) {
        $term = wp_insert_term($cat_name, 'product_cat');
    }
    if (!is_wp_error($term)) {
        $category_ids[$cat_name] = is_array($term) ? $term['term_id'] : $term;
    }
}

// Create products
$created_count = 0;
foreach ($sample_products as $product_data) {
    // Check if product already exists
    $existing = get_page_by_title($product_data['name'], OBJECT, 'product');
    if ($existing) {
        continue;
    }
    
    $product_type = isset($product_data['type']) ? $product_data['type'] : 'simple';
    
    if ($product_type === 'variable') {
        $product = new WC_Product_Variable();
    } else {
        $product = new WC_Product_Simple();
    }
    
    $product->set_name($product_data['name']);
    $product->set_status('publish');
    $product->set_catalog_visibility('visible');
    $product->set_description($product_data['description']);
    $product->set_short_description($product_data['short_description']);
    
    if (isset($product_data['regular_price']) && $product_data['regular_price']) {
        $product->set_regular_price($product_data['regular_price']);
    }
    if (isset($product_data['sale_price'])) {
        $product->set_sale_price($product_data['sale_price']);
    }
    if (isset($product_data['sku'])) {
        $product->set_sku($product_data['sku']);
    }
    if (isset($product_data['virtual']) && $product_data['virtual']) {
        $product->set_virtual(true);
    }
    if (isset($product_data['downloadable']) && $product_data['downloadable']) {
        $product->set_downloadable(true);
    }
    
    // Set stock
    $product->set_manage_stock(true);
    $product->set_stock_quantity(100);
    $product->set_stock_status('instock');
    
    // Set categories
    if (isset($product_data['categories'])) {
        $cat_ids = array();
        foreach ($product_data['categories'] as $cat_name) {
            if (isset($category_ids[$cat_name])) {
                $cat_ids[] = $category_ids[$cat_name];
            }
        }
        $product->set_category_ids($cat_ids);
    }
    
    $product_id = $product->save();
    
    // Handle variable products with variations
    if ($product_type === 'variable' && isset($product_data['attributes'])) {
        $attributes = array();
        foreach ($product_data['attributes'] as $attr_data) {
            $attribute = new WC_Product_Attribute();
            $attribute->set_name($attr_data['name']);
            $attribute->set_options($attr_data['options']);
            $attribute->set_visible($attr_data['visible']);
            $attribute->set_variation($attr_data['variation']);
            $attributes[] = $attribute;
        }
        $product->set_attributes($attributes);
        $product->save();
        
        // Create variations
        $base_price = 45.00;
        $colors = array('Blue', 'Green', 'Red');
        $sizes = array('Small', 'Medium', 'Large');
        
        foreach ($colors as $color) {
            foreach ($sizes as $size) {
                $variation = new WC_Product_Variation();
                $variation->set_parent_id($product_id);
                $variation->set_attributes(array(
                    'color' => $color,
                    'size' => $size
                ));
                $variation->set_regular_price($base_price);
                $variation->set_manage_stock(true);
                $variation->set_stock_quantity(50);
                $variation->set_stock_status('instock');
                $variation->save();
            }
        }
    }
    
    $created_count++;
}

echo "Created $created_count WooCommerce sample products successfully!";

<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

// Create WooCommerce pages if they don't exist
if (function_exists('WC')) {
    // Ensure WooCommerce pages are created
    WC_Install::create_pages();
    
    // Flush rewrite rules
    flush_rewrite_rules();
    
    echo 'WooCommerce pages created successfully.';
} else {
    echo 'WooCommerce not loaded yet.';
}
